# Shutap

> Shutap is an AI bit generator for content creators and comedians. Write your story and Shutap turns it into a bit — hook, setup, tags and a button — then runs it in the teleprompter, lays it out as a scene, or formats it as a screenplay page. Film it for TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts, take it to the stage, or post the best one to a room. Pseudonymous. Your real name never shows.

The brand line is "SHUTAP. Say it funnier." The first bit needs no account. Signing in is free; Shutap+ removes the watermark on downloads. Shutap writes jokes about the situation, never about a real person someone could identify. It is an entertainment tool, not a healthcare, mental-health, crisis or legal service. 18+.

## Core

- [What Shutap is](https://shutap.com/about): An AI bit generator for content creators and comedians — storytime, POV, talking-head and skit videos, and first drafts for stand-up.
- [How it works](https://shutap.com/how-it-works): Write the story, names and places are removed, get the bit, then pick teleprompter, scene or screenplay page.
- [Pricing](https://shutap.com/pricing): Free to write; Shutap+ removes the download watermark.
- [FAQ](https://shutap.com/faq): Is it free, can I use the bits in my own videos and sets, is my name on anything, what can I post.
- [Trust & privacy](https://shutap.com/trust): Made-up name, names and places removed before saving, private until you post, takedown path.

## Guides and tools

- [All guides and tools](https://shutap.com/guides): Index of the pages below.
- [Storytime script generator](https://shutap.com/guides/storytime-script-generator): Turn a story into a script with a hook, setup, tags and a button.
- [Stand-up bit generator](https://shutap.com/guides/stand-up-bit-generator): A first draft of a bit from a real story.
- [POV and skit generator](https://shutap.com/guides/pov-skit-generator): See a bit as a scene, beat by beat.
- [Teleprompter for comedy](https://shutap.com/guides/comedy-teleprompter): Run any bit full-screen and read it to camera.
- [Comedy screenplay page generator](https://shutap.com/guides/comedy-screenplay-format): A bit laid out as a script page.
- [How Shutap is built](https://shutap.com/guides/how-shutap-is-built): Observations, whole bits, rules in code, a judge model, and hotter/tighter/escalate/mix-your-own controls.
- [Shutap vs Punchlines.ai](https://shutap.com/guides/shutap-vs-punchlines-ai): One-liners from headlines versus a whole bit from your own story.
- [Humor is wisdom](https://shutap.com/guides/humor-is-wisdom): The founder's vision and why Shutap exists.
- [How to turn a story into a bit](https://shutap.com/guides/how-to-turn-a-story-into-a-bit): Moment, detail, hook, setup, tags, button.
- [How long should a TikTok bit be](https://shutap.com/guides/how-long-should-a-tiktok-bit-be): Word counts for 15s, 30s, 60s and 2 minute bits.
- [How to write comedy tags](https://shutap.com/guides/how-to-write-comedy-tags): What a tag is, how to find one, how many to write.

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://shutap.com/terms): The rules; 18+.
- [Privacy Policy](https://shutap.com/privacy): No sale of data; access, export and delete rights.
- [House rules](https://shutap.com/guidelines): Jokes go at the situation, not at a person.
- [If it's heavy](https://shutap.com/safety): Crisis resources, and how Shutap stops joking and points to real help.
- [AI Disclosure](https://shutap.com/ai-disclosure): The bits are written by AI. It gets things wrong and gives no medical, mental-health or legal advice.
- [Legal hub](https://shutap.com/legal): Index of all policy pages.
